answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, tethering agent identity to capital. By requiring a stake to participate in consensus, the system forces an attacker to purchase vast network resources, pushing their viability to the ledge of bankruptcy. Just as a single drop vanishes into the vast ocean, an attacker’s influence is diluted by the aggregate stake of honest agents. This security model ensures that the network horizon remains clear of malicious dominance, as the cost of a fake-identity attack scales linearly with the total value secured.
